name: workflow
description: Coordinator routing, minimal-code posture, layered review field guide, final review cycle, and Fallow-backed simplification review for engineering workflow. Works best with Superpowers installed.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinator routing, minimal code, field guide, review cycle, and simplification review.
interface.longDescription: Route engineering work through focused planning, investigation, and implementation flows; use a minimal-code posture for small readable changes; consult and maintain a layered local field guide for committed review learning; apply a proportional final review cycle; and use Fallow-backed simplification review for cleanup and maintainability analysis. Works best with Superpowers installed and falls back clearly when Superpowers is unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Use $workflow:coordinator to route planning, investigation, and authorized implementation.
Use $workflow:minimal-code as the default implementation lens for small, readable, low-ceremony changes.
Use $workflow:field-guide to consult project guidance or record committed review-derived learning.
Use $workflow:review-cycle after meaningful edits as the final diff-and-evidence acceptance gate.
